purpose: Independent practice of B2.3, B2.4, B2.5.
student_learning_goal: I can add and subtract numbers to 1000 using mental chunking and the standard algorithm.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can add and subtract numbers to 1000 using mental chunking and the standard algorithm.
header.character_watermark: Tony the Toolkit Master in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Solve each problem with mental chunking. Show your steps.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Four chunking work-areas in a 2x2 grid, each with a problem at top: (C1) 276 + 458; (C2) 503 - 247; (C3) 624 + 189; (C4) 700 - 365. Each work-area has space for chunking notation.

image_placeholders.description: 2x2 grid of 4 chunking work-areas: C1 276+458, C2 503-247, C3 624+189, C4 700-365. Each cell shows the problem at top and blank space for chunked steps.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image shows 4 chunking problems matching the lesson's mental-math approach; instructions ask children to chunk each problem and show their steps.

parts.student_instructions: Solve each problem with the standard algorithm. Show regrouping clearly.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of the page. Four column-stacks in a 2x2 grid: (A1) 376 + 248; (A2) 612 - 275; (A3) 459 + 186; (A4) 800 - 256. Each stack has cross-out + carry space.

image_placeholders.description: 2x2 grid of 4 column-stacks: A1 376+248, A2 612-275, A3 459+186, A4 800-256. Each stack has cross-out + carry space.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image shows 4 algorithm column-stacks; instructions ask children to use the standard algorithm with explicit regrouping.

parts.student_instructions: Read each story. Choose chunking or algorithm. Show your work and write the answer.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three story problem boxes stacked.

image_placeholders.description: Three story-problem boxes in B&W line-art, stacked vertically, each ~7in × 1.5in. Pre-filled stories: S1 'Tony has 456 nails. He uses 178 today. How many left?' S2 'Maya sold 234 books. She wants to sell 1000 total. How many more?' S3 'Tony's hardware store earned $389 yesterday and $475 today. Total?'
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; three stories stacked.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_THREE_STORIES: keywords (story, problem) name what the boxes show.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write your own story problem with totals to 1000. Solve it.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Use Part 2 #A2 and #A4 (subtraction with regrouping) as the strongest tests of the algorithm. Watch for silent-regroup errors.
